name: Unfinished Business
source:
Struggling to make ends meet, you find yourself in the employ of an odd group of lingering spirits. Join 'Unfinished Business' in their mission to free these lost souls; bound to this world by their ties to the living.

[From [url=https://doccsoccs.itch.io/unfinished-business]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
为了维持生计，你受雇于一群奇怪的滞留幽灵。加入“未了之事”组织，帮助这些被生者牵绊、困在现世的迷失灵魂获得自由。

[来源：[url=https://doccsoccs.itch.io/unfinished-business]Itch.io[/url]]
